Changes:
0: [adoption, layout] Carousel Pet Selection Gallery: Change pick_friend screen layout to an animated carousel with full-size interactive previews of pet animations. (why: The adoption stage drops significantly (60.9% conversion), requiring stronger visual delight to convert users.)
1: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Screen Tips & Animations: Display interactive pet trivia carousel and desktop shortcut tips while pet generation is in progress. (why: Waiting step drop-off is high and average wait time reaches 2336s mean, causing users to abandon during generation.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Story Welcome Copy: Shorten story intro to a crisp two-sentence welcome focusing on desk companionship benefits. (why: Mean time spent on story/choose_path step is over 8 minutes (514s mean), signaling text heavy friction before starting.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Name & Badge Preview: Add an official adoption certificate badge and custom naming celebratory card right after selecting a pet. (why: Strengthening emotional ownership before the waiting phase reduces drop-offs between adoption and final completion.)
